item.title: Missing 13-year-old Florida girl recently seen in Indianapolis, police say
item.description: Indiana State Police are asking for the public's help to locate a missing 13-year-old girl from Florida who was recently seen in Indianapolis and is believed to be in danger.

item.title: Reports: Colts planning to work out Philip Rivers
item.description: INDIANAPOLIS (WISH) — The Colts are planning on bringing in quarterback Philip Rivers for a workout on Tuesday, according to a report from NFL Network’s Ian Rapoport. item.title: Andrew Nembhard’s 28 points, 12 assists lead Pacers past Kings
item.description: Andrew Nembhard had 28 points and 12 assists as the Indiana Pacers beat the Sacramento Kings 116-105 on Monday night. Russell Westbrook had a triple-double for the Kings.

item.title: Eli Lilly’s Mounjaro joins China’s health insurance scheme, challenging competitors
item.description: Mounjaro from Indianapolis-based pharmaceutical giant Eli Lilly and Co. will be added to China's state-run health insurance scheme from Jan. 1, which could put pressure on competitors such as Novo Nordisk and Innovent Biologics.

item.title: Back to the 40s into midweek with multiple systems inbound | Dec. 8, 2025
item.description: After 12 days of below-normal temperatures, a warm and breezy day is expected on Tuesday, followed by a cold front bringing rain and snow showers on Wednesday, with the potential for subzero wind chill values this weekend.

item.title: Kroger announces price cuts on thousands of items
item.description: Beef prices are up nearly 15%, Kroger is cutting prices on 3,500 items, Netflix stock dropped after its Warner Bros. Discovery deal, the Federal Reserve is meeting this week, and 58% of Americans want cash for Christmas.

item.title: Indiana Senate panel advances congressional redistricting bill
item.description: A committee of Indiana state senators on Dec. 8, 2025, advanced House Bill 1032 to redraw Indiana's congressional districts, and heard public testimony for and against the measure.

item.title: Man shot by wife while children were inside home, IMPD says
item.description: A man was taken to the hospital in critical condition after an overnight shooting on the city's southwest side, Indianapolis police said.

item.title: DNA confirms Franklin man as father in incest case
item.description: Issac Cole, a Franklin man, has been charged with incest after police confirmed through DNA testing that he is the father of a baby produced from a relationship with a family member.

item.title: Morgan County sheriff: Intruder attacks police dog, officers respond with gunfire
item.description: According to the Morgan County sheriff, a police dog was sent into a home to apprehend an intruder, who hit the dog with an object, knocking it out, and was then officers shot the man.
